notes: A 21 gal vertical wheeled compressor (its manual cover shows the McGraw name) rated 120 VAC, 60 Hz, 14 A that restarts at 135 psi and shuts off at 175 psi. The parts list has item numbers only, and the motor is filed as universal only because the list includes brushes; check the motor before assuming a type.

gaps: The parts list gives item numbers only, with no OEM part numbers, so parts are keyed by item number.
The motor type is not named; the parts list has a stator, a rotor, a brush box and brushes, so the motor is filed under the universal key on the brushes alone.
The spec table's electrical rating (120VAC / 60Hz / 14A) is for the compressor, not stated for the motor, so no v or a is set on the motor; it is in the notes.
The parts list gives no pump heading or motor heading; the pump and motor parts are grouped by what the items are called.
The parts list has two regulator items (77 Pressure Regulator and 82 Regulator, qty 1 each); the manual does not say whether both are fitted.
The parts list has two fans (items 4 and 29) with no purpose given, so they are not assigned to the motor or the pump.
The tension springs (item 30, qty 2) are not tied to the brushes in the manual, so they are left out.
The air flow of 4.0 SCFM at 90 psi (spec table, p. 5) is not claimed.
Page 10 mentions "proper pump lubrication" when siting the unit, while the cover says oil free; the cover is used for the oil_lube absent claim, which the fact-check added.
No production years are given; the manual copyright is 2022.
method: Harbor Freight Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions for item 64858 (copyright 2022), PDF on manuals.harborfreight.com, read as text with the research tool; the cover and the parts list page were rendered and read as images.
Pages used: 1 cover (21 gallon oil free vertical air compressor, McGraw name), 5 specification table, 10 pressure switch operation text, 14 parts list.
Other Harbor Freight and Central Pneumatic 21 gal manuals (items 94667, 69091 and 67847) turned up in search but were third-party mirrors and were not used.
